connectors.title: Connectors
connectors.desc: Connect OpenClaw AI to messaging platforms and configure mobile remote access

mobileIp.title: Mobile App Connection
mobileIp.desc: Enter the address below into your phone's ClawNo.11 app to connect
mobileIp.noIpHint: Please connect your computer to WiFi or Ethernet first.
mobileIp.availableAddresses: Available connection addresses (copy one to your phone):
mobileIp.step1: Install ClawNo.11 on your phone (iOS: TestFlight / App Store, Android: APK)
mobileIp.step2: Open the app → Connect tab → paste or type one of the addresses above
mobileIp.step3: Tap 'Test Connection' → if successful, tap 'Add' to save
mobileIp.portNote: Port 18800 is the Chat Proxy — it listens on all network interfaces so your phone can reach it over LAN. If you have a firewall, make sure this port is allowed. On Windows, set your network to 'Private'.

tailscale.title: Tailscale VPN
tailscale.accessHint: Enter this URL in the ClawNo.11 mobile app's Connect page (phone must have Tailscale installed and joined to the same network).
tailscale.installHint: With Tailscale, you can securely access your home AI from 5G or any WiFi — no public IP or port forwarding needed.
tailscale.privacyNote: Note: Tailscale uses a coordination server to establish an encrypted tunnel. Traffic is end-to-end encrypted — Tailscale cannot read it.

weixin.title: WeChat ClawBot
weixin.subtitle: Chat with OpenClaw AI inside WeChat
weixin.desc: Install the WeChat plugin to chat with AI directly in WeChat. The plugin connects via the OpenClaw channel protocol with text messaging and streaming replies.
weixin.installWait: First install downloads dependencies — please wait (~1-2 min)
weixin.pluginReady: WeChat plugin is installed — tap the button below to scan & connect
weixin.scanHint: Open WeChat → Scan → Scan the QR code above
weixin.qrExpired: QR code expired — tap 'Show WeChat QR Code' to generate a new one
weixin.qrTimeout: QR code generation timed out — check that OpenClaw is running and try again
weixin.step1: Make sure OpenClaw is installed and running on this machine (complete setup on the Deploy page)
weixin.step2: Click 'Install WeChat Plugin' and wait for installation to finish
weixin.step3: Click 'Show WeChat QR Code' and scan it with WeChat
weixin.step4: Once scanned, send messages to ClawBot in WeChat to chat with AI

xedge.title: xEdge (WeChat Login — Easiest)
xedge.subtitle: WeChat login · No public server · Zero-config networking
xedge.desc: xEdge is a Tailscale-compatible mesh networking tool. Log in with WeChat, devices automatically receive 100.x.x.x IPs via relay nodes. Free tier: 20 devices, 1 GB relay traffic/month.
xedge.step1: Download and install the xEdge client on this machine (the one running ClawNo.11)
xedge.step2: Open the xEdge client, scan the QR code with WeChat — this machine automatically joins your private network and receives a 100.x.x.x IP
xedge.step3: Install the xEdge client on your phone (iOS / Android), scan with the same WeChat account
xedge.step4: Phone and PC are now on the same private network. In the ClawNo.11 mobile app's Connect page, enter the Tailscale IP shown in the Tailscale panel above, e.g. http://100.x.x.x:18789
xedge.tip: xEdge is Tailscale-protocol compatible — once connected, the Tailscale panel above will automatically show the 100.x.x.x IP
xedge.free: Free tier: 20 devices · 1 GB/month relay traffic
